boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 119 is a Super Hard packing board — numbered pillars and arrow-marked polyomino pieces must route through a U-shaped corridor with no room for error. A fixed Lego brick cluster blocks one arm of the U, and the rainbow right-strip can only exit in one direction. Force it before the green snake path and purple winding shape have left and the U corridor locks for good.
landmarks: Block Out Level 119 is a Super Hard packing board — numbered pillars and arrow-marked polyomino pieces must route through a U-shaped corridor with no room for error.
A fixed Lego brick cluster blocks one arm of the U, and the rainbow right-strip can only exit in one direction.
Force it before the green snake path and purple winding shape have left and the U corridor locks for good.

quickTips: Clear the bottom-left Lego cluster before the right rainbow stack, or the U corridor closes.
Keep the right `8` column parked until the lower `2` pocket has room to shift.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the top-left blue `3` marker and open space around the left orange-bordered `14` pillar.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the bottom-left Lego brick cluster (green/red/blue/yellow) without sealing the central U corridor.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed the right tall purple `8` column only after the bottom `2` pocket has room to shift.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Route the rainbow right-stack through the lower grid using the green right-arrow lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the numbered cyan `1` tile sitting in the U-opening once the left `3` tower thins.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the bottom counters `8` and `1` and exit the arrow-directed green L on the lower left.

failurePoints: Routing the rainbow right-stack before the bottom-left Lego cluster clears — this seals the U corridor.
Shifting the right `8` column while the lower `2` pocket is still boxed in.
